sharedStateObservations.description: The refactor-worker skill's file-deletion procedure says to grep for references and remove/update them in the same feature, but this mission deliberately split that work into a separate follow-up feature (`cleanup-file-references`).
sharedStateObservations.why: This creates avoidable 'procedure mismatch' noise during scrutiny even when the worker correctly follows the feature boundary. Evidence: `.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md` step 3 vs `/home/shuv/.factory/missions/1e8791af-a113-4b92-81a8-45beb67de026/features.json`, which separates `remove-narrative-files` from `cleanup-file-references`.

sharedStateObservations.description: Mission wording treats `NEW_LYRICS_*.md` as a root-level cleanup target, but the pre-change repository state had no root matches and instead had ten matching files under `part64/`.
sharedStateObservations.why: Recording this layout detail would help future validators and reviewers avoid false negatives when checking the file-cleanup milestone.
